stem:
Nalini has two identical cells for a torch.

Which arrangement makes a working battery?

options.text: The positive terminal of one cell touching the positive terminal of the other cell.
The positive terminal of one cell touching the negative terminal of the other cell.
The two cells in the holder with their terminals not touching.
Any arrangement of the two cells, because two cells always make a battery.

teacher.key_rationale: A working battery joins cells positive-to-negative so they form one electrical source.
